items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I was fortunate enough to work in the lounge with Mavis Rivers... And I was there with her and I had a chance to meet the entertainment director

ctx.x:
passed away.

That was my first hope and it looked like everything went down with him because he was a nice man, to receive me the way he did. And he understood what I was trying to say. He had a capacity for the music.

And it looked like it was hitting the bottom for me again. I went out again, and I made a couple of breakthroughs, through the entertainment directors, at least to talk to them, a couple of them. But one that really was like the straw that broke the camel's back, I should say...At the M-G-M they were like new, they had just opened, sort of. And the first, at the grand opening, I was fortunate enough to work in the lounge with Mavis Rivers. Mavis Rivers was one of the opening acts in the lounge and she was there…

And after the engagement and everything, I made my way back to Bill DeAngeles and started talking to him about it. Because I felt the M-G-M was the ideal place. Here's a hotel, brand new, coming in with new policies, new concepts. They had jai alai, a whole new concept of gambling, that game, jai alai from Mexico. They had downstairs a theater where nostalgia movies were shown, through the old M-G-M archives, and all of that. And I was saying, 'That's the spot, because I know they're open minded about the…
